name: Seal of Fate
storyline: The "Seal of Fate" story centers on the Ginger Squad, a group of adventurers seeking the legendary Seal of Fate, which then involves Princess Vera and her powerful mage sister Khione, leading to the Seal itself appearing as a new, transforming ally to help defeat the Demon King in a lighthearted, anime-inspired RPG adventure. The narrative unfolds through story-driven campaigns with cutscenes styled like manga panels and features a mixture of humor, high-fantasy spectacle, and turn-based strategy combat.
summary: Seal of Fate is a dazzling 3D anime fantasy RPG. Immerse yourself into a world that surpasses all your imaginations, where destiny meets desire. Along the path of fate, dazzling beauties await your choice. Whose fate will intertwine with yours?
